title: CokorSecurity
body:
CokorScurity Plugin

CokorScurity is an all-in-one security plugin for Minecraft servers running on Paper 1.20+.
Key Features

🔐 AdminProtect — Mandatory 2FA PIN system for admin accounts

🌐 AntiVPN — Automatically blocks players using VPN/Proxy

🛡️ AntiBypass — Prevents exploits and command injection attacks

💬 AntiSpam — Blocks chat spam and dangerous characters

🚫 BlockCommand — Restricts sensitive commands to console only

🔍 PluginScanner — Detects suspicious or malicious plugins
Quick Info

Name      : CokorScurity
Version   : 1.0.0
Server    : Paper 1.20 - 1.20.4
Java      : 17+
Size      : 62KB
Prefix    : /cs (cspin, csip, cslog, etc)
Depends   : None

Commands
Command
Description
/cspin
Admin 2FA PIN login
/csip
Manage IP whitelist
/scanplugins
Scan suspicious plugins
/opcheck
Check OP status
/cslog
View incident logs
/csspam
Manage AntiSpam
/csvpn
Manage AntiVPN

Created by
CokorScurity Team — A lightweight, standalone security plugin that requires no additional dependencies.
